verdict.summary: The documentation change correctly closes the identified allocation hazards: it derives the next account number from the complete non-recyclable union of claim refs, issues, repository secrets, and environment secrets; paginates every listing; fails closed when any source cannot be queried; requires the claim before writes; distinguishes claim collision from unknown failure; and checks both secret scopes for explicit absence immediately before the upsert. The commands consistently use exact anchored account-name patterns, exclude pull requests from the issue-title inventory, retain closed issues as reservations, and avoid exposing token values. No vacuous test or workflow/security-check weakening is introduced by this README-only change.
